hooks.name: Auto-start KiroCan Bridge
hooks.description: Starts the KiroCan bridge service if not already running when a Kiro session begins

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:PATH = 'C:\\Program Files\\Git\\bin;C:\\Program Files\\nodejs;' + $env:PATH; $bridge = Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*kirocan*' }; if (-not $bridge) { Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath 'cmd.exe' -ArgumentList '/c cd /d C:\\Users\\mehme\\OneDrive\\Documents\\Repos\\Kirocan\\bridge && npm start' }"
